title: 第13章 无名剑的异动第14章 剑中世界
content_zh:
三个人在后院挥剑到子时。
朱八斗第一个扛不住。
他庞大的身躯在雪地里站了不到两个时辰就开始摇晃，挥剑的动作从生猛变成了敷衍，最后干脆把木剑一扔，一屁股坐在石头上，大口喘着粗气。
“不行了。“他摆摆手。
“你们两个疯子继续，我得去睡了。明天寅时还得起来做饭。“
他摇摇晃晃地走了，留下一串深浅不一的脚印，很快被新雪填平。
陈牧又练了一个时辰。
他的动作比朱八斗扎实得多，每一剑都认认真真，虽然姿势依然笨拙，但没有一剑是敷衍的。
他的额头渗出汗水，在寒冷的空气中凝结成白雾，但他没有停。
直到顾渊说：“够了。“
陈牧收剑，看着顾渊。
“今天到这里。“顾渊说。
“明天继续。“
陈牧点点头，将木剑插回包袱里，背起来，转身向杂役院的住处走去。
他的脚步很稳，但背影已经有些疲惫，肩膀微微倾斜。
顾渊独自站在后院里。
雪小了很多，从鹅毛变成了细碎的雪粒，零零星星地从天空中飘落。
月亮从云层后面探出头来，洒下一片银白色的光辉，将后院照成一片清冷的蓝白色。
顾渊没有立刻回茅草屋。
他站在演武场中央，握着手中的铁剑，闭上眼睛。

冬夜的空气清冽而干燥，吸进肺里带着一丝寒意。
他的呼吸慢慢平稳下来，心跳从剧烈的搏动变成了沉稳的节奏。
然后，他开始挥剑。
不是基础剑诀的一万剑。
那一万剑他已经和陈牧一起挥完了。
他现在练的是破空。
起势、蓄势、引势、发力、穿透、收势、回气。
七个动作，一气呵成。
“铮。“
剑尖发出一声轻啸，白色气痕从剑尖射出，在雪地上划出一道三尺长的痕迹。
比一个月前更长、更深、更稳定。
顾渊没有停下。
他继续挥，一剑接一剑，破空的啸鸣声在寂静的后院中回荡，像是一连串短促而清越的音符。
三十剑。
五十剑。
八十剑。
他的动作越来越快，越来越流畅，七个动作之间的衔接几乎看不出停顿。
content_en:
Three people were wielding swords in the backyard.
Zhu Badou was the first to be unable to bear it.
His huge body started to shake after standing in the snow for less than two hours. His sword-swinging movements changed from vigorous to perfunctory. Finally, he simply threw away the wooden sword and sat down on the stone, breathing heavily.
"No." He waved his hand.
"You two lunatics, go on, I have to go to bed. I have to get up to cook at Yinshi tomorrow."
He staggered away, leaving behind a series of footprints of varying depths, which were soon filled in by new snow.
Chen Mu practiced for another hour.
His movements were much more solid than Zhu Badou's, and he took every strike seriously. Although his posture was still awkward, none of his strikes were perfunctory.
Sweat broke out on his forehead and condensed into white mist in the cold air, but he didn't stop.
Until Gu Yuan said: "That's enough."
Chen Mu sheathed his sword and looked at Gu Yuan.
"We're here today." Gu Yuan said.
"Continue tomorrow."
Chen Mu nodded, put the wooden sword back into the bag, put it on his back, turned around and walked towards the residence of the commissary.
His steps were steady, but his back was a little tired and his shoulders were slightly tilted.
Gu Yuan stood alone in the backyard.
The snow became much lighter, turning from goose feathers into fine snow particles, falling sporadically from the sky.
The moon peeked out from behind the clouds, casting a silvery glow, illuminating the backyard into a cool blue-white.
Gu Yuan did not return to the thatched house immediately.
He stood in the center of the martial arts arena, holding the iron sword in his hand and closing his eyes.
The winter night air is crisp and dry, bringing a chill to the lungs.
His breathing slowly calmed down, and his heartbeat changed from a violent beating to a steady rhythm.
Then he started swinging his sword.
It's not the Ten Thousand Swords of Basic Sword Technique.
He had already finished wielding the ten thousand swords with Chen Mu.
What he is practicing now is breaking through the air.
Starting momentum, accumulating momentum, leading momentum, exerting force, penetrating, closing momentum, and returning energy.
Seven movements, done in one go.
"Zheng."
The tip of the sword let out a slight whistle, and white air marks shot out from the tip of the sword, leaving a three-foot-long mark on the snow.
Longer, deeper and more stable than a month ago.
Gu Yuan didn't stop.
He continued to swing, one sword after another, and the whistling sound echoed in the silent backyard, like a series of short and clear notes.
Thirty swords.
Fifty swords.
Eighty swords.
His movements became faster and smoother, and there was almost no pause in the connection between the seven movements.
